# Yuntong Ke — Visual Design Portfolio

Yuntong Ke is an independent visual designer working across AIGC, visual narrative, cultural research and digital experience.

- [Portfolio](https://www.yuntongke.design/): Selected work, process, profile and contact information.
- [Contact](mailto:keyuntong@126.com): Study, commissions and international collaboration.

The portfolio includes Emotional Weather Bureau, Synthetic Perception Archive, and Shanxi Heritage × Dragon Mythology.
